蓬菜愣了一下，“带来做啥？”

“很快你就会知道了。”

亲手将再莱给送进佛堂里念经后，蓬莱焦急地等在门外足有半日，在大师兄终于愿意开门放人时，他就被一个冲进他怀里的小女娃给紧紧搂住了。

“呜呜，二师兄我念不来、我念不来……”

他赶紧逮住机会教肓，“那下回你还敢不敢不听话？”

“再也不敢了！”

可惜好景没能久长，蓬莱即便掰正了这个再莱，在这座上梁不正下梁歪的师门里，永玩远都有后来居上的新一波挑战者。

蓬莱看着手中害得师门永远都入不敷出的损失清单，痛心疾首地道。

“我究竟造了什么孽？为什么师父收的都是这种师妹！”还他梦想中甜甜又无害的师妹来！

此刻正在书房里罚跪的月穹，两手举着一张沉重的板凳，小声地向他道。

“其实，小九算是很正常的……”

蓬莱晾着白眼，“你知道，疯子通常都说他不是疯子。”

“可小九都说她是疯子。”

“所以她才是真正的疯子呀！”他不要这样的师妹啦。

两手酸得要命的月穹连忙开口，“既然幸福是比较出来的，那可不可以别再罚我了？”

“照罚！”蓬莱哪会放过她这个师门最坏的榜样，“好你个小四，我费心尽力的教你习字作画，你说你都拿来做什么了？瞧瞧你写的画的都是什么东西！”

她低声咕哝，“不就是小黄书嘛……”

“你给我闭嘴！”

几年过后，心力交瘁的蓬莱，脚步蹒跚地走进佛堂内。

“大师兄……我决定以后不成亲生子了。”

“为何？”

“你瞧瞧这些年来，我都养了些什么孩子？”他怔怔然地看着两手，“疯子呆子驱子还有戏子……我养儿肓女失败，我对不起师父啊！”

“……你够了。”他已经完全变成个老妈子了。

翻完了那本观察日志，顾醒深深觉得，这本册子根本就是蓬莱的养妹子血泪心酸史，要想不同情他，都有那么点难。

睡在小床上的再莱揉着眼睛坐起身，顾醒见了即放下手中的书册走过去，将睡得小脸蛋红扑扑的她给搂进怀中。

“睡醒了？”他一下下地啄吻着她，直到把她给亲得不再有半分睡意，再清醒不过。

“嗯。”再莱颇害羞地回吻他一记。

“路露邀你明儿个去驸马府玩，要不要去？”

她兴奋地跳下床，“要！”

“当心一会儿着凉了，快把衣裳穿起来。”顾醒一把拉回想往外跑的她。

“不冷！”

他朗眉一挑，“还想喝苦药？”

再莱二话不说地走回床边穿妥他准备好的衣裳，顾醒满意地点点头，这才放她出门去继续祸害整院子盛开的兰花。

站在窗边看着再莱在花草丛生的院子中玩耍，顾醒不禁想起，在他欲带着再莱返回路国时，蓬莱曾私下找过他，并语重心长地对他道。

“不管小六长到了几岁，她永玩都会像个孩子。”

“我知道。”

蓬菜需要他一个确实的保证，“你能永远照顾她？”

“我能。”顾醒没有回避他的目光。

“不离不弃？”爱上她就得照顾她一辈子。

顾醒定定地道：“我没有凡人的陋习。”别太小看他这名天上仙了。

总算是放下心的蓬莱，在松了口气后，百思不解地问。

“我说你究竟看上了小六什么？”

“她呆吧。”也许就是因为她够单纯够直接。

蓬莱显然对这个答案很不满，大有他不把话说清楚就不给人的意味。

“一直以来，她就是我眼中的孩子，我心中的小姑娘，我在漫长生命中的等待。”顾醒难得说出他从不对人言的心事，并微微一笑，“简单说，她就是我的心愿。”

深感安慰的蓬莱拍着他的肩，“往后小六就拜托你了。”

“知道了，老妈子。”

窗外春光正明媚，顾醒在瞧了一会儿后，决定舍去骨子里的懒性，出去与她一起共度这温暧的午后。

“小莱。”

正在花丛里打滚的再莱，见他也出来哂日了，马上笑意盈然地朝他跑过来，然后挽着他的手臂要求。

“要飞一下！”在知道他和白大叔一样都有仙法会飞后，她时不时就缠着他。

“不是有轻功吗？”她光是一跳就能跃上树顶了。

“不一样。”

“好吧。”他亲亲她的脸蛋，搂紧她后就往天上飞去。

近来这座皇宫里的人们，都已经很习惜惯，动不动就见到有人在天上飞的这类神迹了。

化为一只白鹤睡在路翔椅边的白十一，懒懒地掀了掀眼皮，看了他们一眼后，又翻了个身再度睡过去，而忙碌的路翔就只能选择视而不见，免得他又会羡慕得睡不着觉。

迎着还稍稍有些寒意的东风，顾醒穿过重重云朵，在风中远望着天际的尽头，他仿佛又再次看见了，那曾经再熟悉不过的天上琼楼玉宇。

“怎么了？”再莱不懂他怎么停住了。

他看着怀中的再莱，怀坏的一笑，不再留念地转过身，带她回去那座位处在人间尘中，有着兰花香味的小院子。

【全文完】

后记　绿痕

“你跟你笔下的皇帝有仇是吧？”看了前两章后，仙仙沉重地问。

“有吗？”

“你确定没有？”她不忍卒睹地翻了翻前两章。

紧接着，在经过暗夜和编编相同的质问后，我还是半点悔悟之心也没有。

我想，很多人都忘记这套的系列名了，它叫“阅魂录”，这套书主要讲的就是由魂？所衍生出来的故事。也因此，在我的想法里，故事就是环绕在魂纸、魂主、魂役这三者上头。

我倒不是故意要跟书里当皇帝的过不去，你们想嘛，就是有所求，所以才会想要魂？许出魂役来解决问题，要是一无所求，谁又会要魂？这玩意儿？

所以说，路翔之所以会惨，就是因为他有所求嘛，我总要把他有所求的原因写出来不是？

好吧，虽然某三人还是自始自终都认为，我只是单纯在整他而已。

说起来，这本光从设定上来看，就够让暗夜乐上好几天，也够让编编吐上几斤血了。

“你再说一次。”当编编听完大纲后，光从声音里我就能听出她的杀意。

“龟，四只脚的那种。”我还很老实上禀。

“他是男主角？”

“嗯。”

“你……你再说一次他是怎么死的？”这会儿她气得都笑了。

“呃……”很有危机感的我，缩缩肩头不敢继续吭声。

“第二本湛朗的死因是欠雷劈我认了，第三本这是怎么回事？”她最最不能接受的就是这回的死法。

“不可以吗？”我觉得这死法很合情合理啊。

“他是男主角啊！男主角知不知道？你的脑袋究竟是怎么长的啊？”编编简直就是气急败坏。

“所以我给了他一个特别的死法啦。”这还不满意？

在编编赏我一顿爱的教肓后，当晚我垂头丧气地找到暗夜，顺道吐了盆惑水。

“病友，你说编编到底对龟哪儿不满意？”不是满可爱的吗？

“普通的龟，她当然不会有意见，但当那只龟是你笔下的男主角时，你家编编的意见就会很大了。”

“为何？”狼都可以了龟却不行？

“你去翻翻市面上的言情小说中哪个男主角是只乌角？这是形象破灭的问题。要知道，言小走的是对爱的幻想、是小羊们对虚幻的憧憬，偏偏你实在是太让人没有幻想的动力了，连照妖镜都没你这么打击人。”

Peng Cai was stunned for a moment, "What are you bringing here for?"

"You'll find out soon enough."

After personally taking Zai Lai into the Buddhist hall to chant sutras, Penglai waited anxiously outside the door for half a day. When the senior brother was finally willing to open the door and let him go, he was hugged tightly by a little girl who rushed into his arms.

"Uuuu, Second Senior Brother, I can't read it, I can't read it..."

He quickly seized the opportunity to teach him something, "Then do you dare to disobey me next time?"

"Never again!"

It's a pity that the good times did not last long. Even if Penglai corrected this problem, in this division with its top beam crooked and its bottom beam crooked, there would always be a new wave of challengers coming from behind.

Penglai looked at the list of losses in his hand that caused the sect to never make ends meet, and he felt heartbroken.

"What evil have I done? Why does master accept all these kind of junior sisters!" Give him back the sweet and harmless junior sister in his dream!

Yue Qiong, who was kneeling in the study at the moment, held up a heavy bench with both hands and whispered to him.

"Actually, Xiaojiu is quite normal..."

Penglai rolled his eyes, "You know, crazy people usually say they are not crazy."

"But Xiaojiu said she was crazy."

"So she is the real madman!" He didn't want such a junior sister.

Yue Qiong, whose hands were so sore, quickly said, "Since happiness comes from comparison, can you please stop punishing me?"

"According to the punishment!" How could Penglai let her, the worst role model in the school, let go, "You little fourth, I tried my best to teach you calligraphy and painting, what do you think you did with it? Look at what you wrote and drew!"

She murmured in a low voice, "Isn't it just the little yellow book..."

"Shut up!"

A few years later, Penglai, who was exhausted both mentally and physically, staggered into the Buddhist hall.

"Eldest brother...I have decided not to get married and have biological children in the future."

"Why?"

"Look at what kind of children I have raised over the years?" He looked at his hands blankly, "Madmen, idiots, drivers, and actors... I failed to raise a young child, and I am sorry to the master!"

"...That's enough for you." He has completely turned into an old woman.

After flipping through the observation journal, Gu Xing deeply felt that this book was simply a history of blood, tears and heartache for the adopted girl in Penglai. It was difficult not to sympathize with him.

Zai Lai, who was sleeping on the small bed, rubbed her eyes and sat up. When Gu Xing saw her, he put down the book in his hand and walked over, holding her in his arms with her face flushed from sleep.

"Are you awake?" He kissed her again and again until he kissed her until she was no longer half asleep and could not be awake again.

"Yeah." Zai Laipo shyly kissed him back.

"Lulu invites you to go to the Prince Consort's Mansion tomorrow. Do you want to go?"

She jumped out of bed excitedly, "Yes!"

"Be careful if you catch a cold soon. Put on your clothes quickly." Gu Xing pulled her back and ran out.

"It's not cold!"

He raised his eyebrows and said, "You still want to drink bitter medicine?"

Without saying a word, Zai Lai walked back to the bed and put on the clothes he had prepared. Gu Xing nodded with satisfaction before letting her go out to continue harming the orchids in full bloom in the yard.

Standing by the window and watching Zai Lai playing in the yard full of flowers and grass, Gu Xing couldn't help but remember that when he wanted to take Zai Lai back to Lu Country, Penglai had come to him in private and spoke to him sincerely.

"No matter how old Xiao Liu grows, she will always be like a child."

"I know."

Peng Cai needs a sure guarantee from him, "Can you take care of her forever?"

"I can." Gu Xing did not avoid his gaze.

"Never leave?" If you fall in love with her, you have to take care of her for the rest of your life.

Gu Xing said firmly: "I don't have the bad habits of ordinary people." Don't underestimate this heavenly immortal.

Penglai, who was finally relieved, asked puzzledly after heaving a sigh of relief.

"I said, what do you see in Xiaoliu?"

"Let her stay." Maybe it's because she is simple and direct enough.

Penglai was obviously very dissatisfied with this answer, which seemed to imply that he would not let people know if he did not explain it clearly.

"She has always been the child in my eyes, the little girl in my heart, and what I have been waiting for in my long life." Gu Xing rarely expressed his thoughts that he never told others, and smiled slightly, "Simply put, she is my wish."

Penglai, who was deeply comforted, patted his shoulder and said, "Xiao Liu will be in charge of you from now on."

"I got it, mom."

The spring light outside the window was shining brightly, and after watching it for a while, Gu Xing decided to put aside his laziness and go out to spend this warm afternoon with her.

"Xiao Lai."

Zai Lai, who was rolling in the flowers, saw that he had come out to watch the sun. He immediately ran towards him with a smile, then took his arm and asked.

"I want to fly!" After knowing that he, like Uncle Bai, had the ability to fly, she would pester him from time to time.

"Don't you have Qing Gong?" She could reach the top of the tree with just one jump.

"It's different."

"Okay." He kissed her cheek, hugged her tightly, and flew into the sky.

Recently, people in this palace have become very accustomed to seeing such miracles as people flying in the sky.

Bai Shiyi, who turned into a white crane and slept beside Lu Xiang's chair, lazily opened his eyelids, glanced at them, then turned over and fell asleep again, while the busy Lu Xiang could only choose to turn a blind eye, lest he would be so envious that he could not sleep again.

Facing the east wind that was still slightly chilly, Gu Xing walked through the heavy clouds and looked at the end of the sky in the wind. He seemed to see again the beautiful buildings and jade buildings in the sky that he was so familiar with.

"What's wrong?" Zai Lai didn't understand why he stopped.

He looked at Zai Lai in his arms, smiled mischievously, turned around without remembering her, and took her back to the small courtyard where she was sitting in the dust of the world and smelled of orchids.

[End of full text]

"Is there any?"

"Are you sure you haven't?" She turned over the first two chapters in dismay.

Immediately afterwards, after the same questioning from An Ye and Bianbian, I still had no regrets at all.

I didn’t mean to get in trouble with the emperor in the book. What do you think? I just want something, so I want a soul?Promising soul service to solve the problem, if you want nothing, who would want a soul?This thing?

Well, although some three people still thought from beginning to end that I was just teasing him.

Speaking of which, the setting alone of this book is enough to keep An Ye entertained for several days, and also enough to make the editor vomit several kilograms of blood.

"Isn't it possible?" I think this way of death is very reasonable.

After the editor gave me a lesson on love, that night I went to the dark night dejectedly and vomited my confusion.

"Patient, what do you think I'm dissatisfied with about Gui?" Isn't it so cute?

"Of course she won't have any objection to an ordinary turtle, but when that turtle is the hero of your novel, your editor will have a big objection."

"Take a look at the romance novels on the market, which male protagonist is a black horn? This is a problem of shattered image. You know, Yan Xiaozhao is the fantasy of love, the illusion of lambs, but you are so unmotivated by fantasy that even the magic mirror is not as shocking as you."
